name: Ovarupa
look: a round orange pupa with a dark base, pale yellow infinity marks and lavender spots, a jagged collar round its brown head, green eyes, a great barbed horn on top and two yellow-tipped side horns
entry: Inside its hard orange casing its whole body is being rebuilt. The horn grows out through the top first, and anything that pokes the casing gets jabbed with it.
how: Evolve Larvorub at level 20. It learns Harden when it evolves.
Wild: uncommon in jungles and savannas.
